from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single legal document relevant to the cause-of-action sorting task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action category this document belongs to, matched from the task's provided list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentAnalysis] = Field(description="List of analyzed documents, one entry extracted per document from the collection")
